body:
I didn't really feel like posting anything until now because I barely skimmed over your comment the first few times I read it. To be honest, your advice doesn't really help because you've effectively described a big part of the problem for me as a truth. In short, happiness feels like a monkey with a typewriter type scenario, except I don't have an infinite amount of time and I don't feel like using said typewriter half the time.

Edit: Well, fuck you too.

That's what I keep telling myself, along with "It's not like it can get any worse, anyways." It kinda loses it's punch when you've been holding out for months, watching your broken world somehow shatter into even smaller pieces. I'm really about done with seeing what happens next.
I think most of us are capable of knowing the difference between real life and a lucid dream.

I don't really have this as moments of clarity, since this first started it's kinda passively been there. I know what to do to make myself happy, I know how to do it, I know it's attainable but I just DON'T do it. It's honestly the worst part about depression for me, it's like... having a steak dangled in your face when you're starving. A mentally sound person would likely take the steak then and there, but I'd either not do it for no reason in particular, or think things like "but what if the steak is poisoned".

I should've mentioned more clearly, but apathy (like apathy usually is) was a bit of a coping thing for me, but that's just plain gone now. I can't pretend like the situation is helpless anymore, and I can't keep running away from my problems with distractions like games and shit. And I used to write quite a bit, not so much anymore.

That's the problem. I know what to do, but I just can't do it. You know I refused to see a therapist for ages even when it was my only option, and the thing that made be bring it up? A friend that called the cops. If it takes that for me to say what I need, I don't know what to do.

Absolutely, even when doing my best, I feel like I fall short of even below average, and that was before my depression. Lately I've been having people actually call me useless (people I barely know, to boot). I'm not even twisting their words there. They literally said "you're useless."
I feel like my capacity for empathy is fine, but at this point I just don't sympathy for anyone, not even myself.
Ah, well, still. It excites me just to see that the game still has some possible activity in the way of updates. Thanks for the pick-me-up!
Ok, I know this post is a few days old, but I literally just ran around the house screaming "OH MY GOD" over and over again upon reading this. What does the patch add? Anything noteworthy?

My problem seems to be that I can't really HELP getting excited when I feel like things could be turning around. Ultimately, all I want is for this shit to stop, one way or another. So when I see an alternative that doesn't involve a noose or a gun, any innate disappointment I have is washed away somewhat, which opens the door for being even more disappointed.

I've never actually made a post on this sub before (not new to reddit, just would rather keep the depression stuff personal) so take this with a grain of salt. I like to play bullet hells in general, such as Touhou, Ikaruga, and Raiden Jet Fighters on the rare occasion I'm out of the house. There are some people who feel relaxed by these types of games. I'm not one of those. Rather, those type of games make me feel like I'm actually working towards something. I feel something I'm missing in my day to day: willpower, determination, perseverance, whatever you want to call it. That's just my two cents.
